name: sampling_effort_daily_cellres_025_v2
description: Daily Mosquito Alert sampling effort per 0.025 degree cell, version 2. Differences from the v1 dataset: (1) reporting propensity comes from the corrected discrete-hazard estimator (v2), whose risk sets exclude participants who had already left the system; (2) SE_expected and SE are computed from participation-tenure BINS (boundaries in days: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 181, 731) rather than exact tenures, a privacy-motivated design audited against trajectory-reconstruction attacks; (3) coverage starts in 2018, when the 0.025 degree sampling cells were introduced. Per-bin participant counts and per-bin propensities are not yet included in this release pending completion of the privacy review; when they are added, published SE values will not change, since they are already computed from the bins. Participant presence combines background tracks and report-location evidence exactly as in v1. Known upstream data-loss gaps: 19-26 July 2022 (21, 22 and 24 July entirely empty) and 18-19 April 2026; treat as missing, not zero.
